Description: A skin condition caused by fungi. It often causes itching, redness and rashes, and is usually treatable with antifungal medicine.
The body's reaction to something it is sensitive to, such as pollen, dust or food. It can cause sneezing, itching and watery eyes.
Gastroesophageal reflux disease. Stomach acid flows back into the food pipe, causing heartburn, acidity and chest discomfort.
A long-term condition where blood sugar levels stay too high. Common signs include tiredness, increased thirst, hunger and frequent urination.
A mild viral infection of the nose and throat that causes sneezing, cough, runny nose and sometimes a mild fever.
A mosquito-borne infection that causes high fever with chills, sweating, headache and body pain. It needs medical treatment.
A mosquito-borne viral illness causing high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, and joint and muscle pain.
A bacterial infection spread through contaminated food or water. It causes prolonged fever, weakness and stomach pain.
A type of headache, often on one side, that can come with nausea, sensitivity to light and visual disturbances.
High blood pressure. It often has no clear symptoms but can cause headaches, dizziness and chest discomfort over time.
